result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: the cap is mutual and based on 12 months’ fees paid or payable, with uncapped carve-outs for Section 8 liabilities (apparently indemnification), confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct. It also appropriately excludes Corio’s fee-payment obligations from the cap and adds authorized fraud and IP-infringement carve-outs. It does not reach the preferred position because it lacks the USD 1,000,000 floor and data protection/security carve-outs. The changes are confined to the liability allocation and preserve unrelated intent. Drafting quality is materially reduced by the retained duplicated and malformed text beginning “10 LIABILITY RELATES,” and by using “this limitation” rather than stating precisely that payment obligations are not damages subject to the cap.
